note: Retry of rl_c2st_wae_HDGM_d2_power.py (lambda_mmd=10), which underperformed C2ST at N=1000 and N=2000 (0.020/0.050 and 0.060/0.030 vs C2ST's 0.150/0.300 and 0.470/0.830), and got WORSE from N=1000 to N=2000 on the L statistic -- genuine signal erosion from over-regularization, not a warmup issue (reconstruction was already low, 0.0018, in the broken run). Fixed by lowering LAMBDA_TARGET from 10.0 to 1.0, confirmed via diagnostic before this run.
